delivery.outcome: Publish an experimental, deterministic data comparison contract v0 with golden-case fixtures and conformance evidence.
nonGoals: Modify subactor/twin, wellmanifest/dsl, or any repository other than data2dsl.
Implement acquisition adapters, GitHub access, reasoning, enforcement, or a stable public API.

architecture.decision: Own only a local effect-free comparison profile and compose immutable Wellmanifest profile contracts by reference; do not copy or change external contracts.
architecture.rollback: Remove the experimental contract directory and return Phase 1B to planning; no runtime data migration is required.

validation.evidence: Both golden fixtures and embedded negative cases are checked deterministically.
The external pinned checker accepts the local manifest and governance remains green.
